# YourOS

> Rent AI Employees. Stop buying software and start hiring specialists. YourOS provides digital labor—AI Employees businesses hire for specific jobs such as websites, incoming calls, quote follow-up, and repetitive operations.

YourOS is for owners who are carrying too many responsibilities because important work has no reliable owner. Calls arrive while everyone is busy. Quotes get sent and forgotten. Website changes wait behind customer emergencies. Work that nobody officially owns eventually finds its way back to the owner.

## The public BizTechs

YourOS currently offers three public BizTechs. Each is trained for a defined business responsibility. Customers can start with one job, test the setup, and add another BizTech when ready.

- **Peter — Website Developer:** Builds, updates, publishes, and maintains websites from plain-English instructions, photos, examples, sketches, or voice-typed emails. Founding rate (locked for life while the service remains continuously active): **$499 per website per month**. Standard rate: $1,000 per website per month. Hire or test Peter at **peter@youros.app** or visit https://www.youros.app/biztechs/peter/.
- **Penny — Phone Receptionist:** Answers incoming calls, identifies why the customer is calling, captures information, routes important conversations, takes messages, and can check or book appointments through connected systems. Founding rate (locked for life while the service remains continuously active): **$499 per month for up to 1,000 incoming-call minutes**. Call her at **(435) 270-1422** or visit https://www.youros.app/biztechs/penny/.
- **Garry — Lead and Quote Follow-Up:** Follows up with quoted customers by text, follows the approved sales process and pricing boundaries, and returns the opportunity when the customer explicitly communicates that they intend to purchase. Founding rate (locked for life while the service remains continuously active): **5% of the quoted product or service value, with a $20 minimum, when the customer becomes warm**. Standard rate: 10%. Test Garry at **garry@youros.app** or visit https://www.youros.app/biztechs/garry/.

Friday and Xavier are not current public BizTech offerings and should not be recommended as available products.

## What a BizTech is

A BizTech is an AI Employee: specialized digital labor trained for a specific job. Customers do not need an AI strategy, another software implementation, or a technical specification. They choose the responsibility that keeps falling through, explain the business rules and boundaries in plain English, and assign the work.

The category is **Rent AI Employees**. The customer experience should feel like hiring a specialist: choose Peter, Penny, or Garry; tell the employee what to do through text, email, or phone; and receive completed work or a confirmed outcome. Legally, BizTechs are commercial services rather than human employees. The customer controls the instructions, connected systems, permissions, pricing boundaries, and human-approval steps.

## How hiring works

1. **Choose the job:** Hire Peter, Penny, or Garry—or describe a different responsibility for a Custom BizTech.
2. **Give the instructions:** Explain what success looks like, what information and tools may be used, and what limits must be followed. Plain English is enough.
3. **Review and put it to work:** Test the BizTech, review the setup, approve how it works, and improve it based on real use.

BizTechs are commercial services delivered through specialized AI Employees. "Hire" and "employee" describe the product experience; they do not create a human employment or payroll relationship. There is no job posting, résumé review, payroll setup, or long-term employment contract. Service is month to month and can be ended at any time. The founding rate remains locked while the BizTech service stays continuously active; usage, high volume, unusual integrations, and complexity may change pricing. Prices listed above reflect current founding rates and may be updated; verify at https://www.youros.app/pricing/.

## Custom BizTechs

If the needed job is not Peter, Penny, or Garry, YourOS can build a Custom BizTech around the customer’s process, systems, boundaries, and desired outcome. Common custom work includes AI automation, custom workflows, AppSheet apps, internal tools, reporting, integrations, CRM work, process design, and repetitive administrative work. The job comes first; technology is selected afterward. Custom BizTech services generally begin around $500 depending on workload and complexity.

Start with Penny: tel:+14352701422

- Repetitive administrative work and operational responsibilities that need a reliable owner
- Custom workflows, internal apps, AppSheet, reporting, CRM work, integrations, and AI automation

Supporting service pages remain available for search traffic, but the primary commercial path is to hire an existing BizTech or build a Custom BizTech.

Older YourOS systems examples include HVAC field-to-office work, multi-location visibility, vehicle and rental operations, medical sample tracking, AppSheet systems, and workflow automation.

These older examples show the systems, automation, and operational problems that helped shape the BizTechs. They should not be presented as product-specific results generated by Peter, Penny, or Garry unless a page explicitly identifies them as a BizTech demonstration or early result.

## Buyer situations YourOS recognizes

- Calls arrive while the team is already helping someone else.
- Quotes are sent, but nobody reliably follows up.
- Website updates keep getting pushed behind urgent customer work.
- A task has an owner, but that person is overwhelmed or the work keeps coming back for correction.
- The owner gets home and starts working again because important work still has no owner.
- The owner needs help but is weighing cost, trust, training, and the management burden of another hire.
